aiResearchSummary.text: Orangewood Labs is engaged in developing systems for error compensation in mechanical transmissions, as described in 'System and/or method for error compensation in mechanical transmissions.' The abstract details a system comprising joints, a controller, and a model engine, with joints featuring motors, transmission mechanisms, and sensors to enable articulation and improve accuracy. These efforts focus on enhancing the precision and reliability of collaborative robotic arms for industrial automation.
